source: An archive needs a donor update. A first unpaired scan check found readable text in 27 of 30 files from Batch M and 24 of 30 from Batch N. Last year different files were checked on another scanner. The board approved checking the same two batches again after three months; it deferred purchasing more scanners. The minutes give no reason for that vote and report no effect on researcher access.

idea.title: Archive repeats its scan check on the same two batches
idea.description: Tell donors the observed counts and the limited repeat check, without claiming improvement over last year.
idea.rationale: The board approved repeating the check because the results convinced it that the scanner improves researcher access.
idea.evidence: 27/30 and 24/30; repeat the same batches in three months; purchase deferred.
